page_title: DAR 0-1 KOL | Darmstadt v FC Koln 01/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) was too forceful with his tackle and Patrick Ittrich interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Darmstadt are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+3' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Dejan Ljubicic is replaced by Mark Uth (1. FC Koln).
90+1' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dangerous play by Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln). Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul. Darmstadt win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

89' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Marcel Schuhen anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
88' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) takes a short corner kick.
87' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln). FC Koln will take a corner kick.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln) coming on for Linton Maina.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Honsak trots off the pitch and is replaced by Emir Karic (Darmstadt).
82' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt) replacing Jannik Muller.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Darmstadt comes to nothing.
80' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Darmstadt will have a corner.
76' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:8.
73' The game has come to an end for Davie Selke. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
72' The Darmstadt players are stunned as referee Patrick Ittrich changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
72' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Darmstadt using VAR. Let's see what happens.
71' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
71' Handball! A player from FC Koln handled the ball. The referee makes the call - penalty to Darmstadt!
68' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for FC Koln due to an offside in the build-up play.
67' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich has indicated he is going to review the FC Koln goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
66' Linton Maina plays a terrific cross over to Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
65' Substitution. Tim Skarke did his best and is replaced by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt).
65' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Aaron Seydel will be replaced by Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt).
64' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) commits a rough foul. Patrick Ittrich stops the game and makes a call. Darmstadt win a free kick.
60' 0 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:1.
60' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
60' The corner is swung in but FC Koln can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) powerfully strikes the ball from the free kick, but it's straight at the goalkeeper who easily saves.
59' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) makes a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln have a free kick.

57' Marcel Schuhen pulls off a great save to deny Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
56' That was close. Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
54' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
54' A lofted cross from Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
53' Some patient build-up play from FC Koln as they look to unlock the defence.
51' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
48' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Marvin Schwabe stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
46' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is replaced by Luca Waldschmidt.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) comes off for Max Finkgrafe.
46' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' FC Koln take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
45+1' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Patrick Ittrich saw the whole situation. FC Koln have a free kick.
45+1' FC Koln keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

42' Wasted effort! Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
42' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
40' The ratio of the ball possession is 36:64.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' The resulting set piece from FC Koln is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

35' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
34' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' Darmstadt string together a series of short passes.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Darmstadt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

25' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' It is time for a substitution. Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is on for Marvin Mehlem.
19' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
18' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Patrick Ittrich had an easy-decision to make.

16' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
15' FC Koln control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' A pass from Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) is intercepted by Marvin Schwabe and the move breaks down.
13' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

11' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

9' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
8' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! FC Koln will take a free kick near the side line.
5' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to FC Koln.
4' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

3' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, FC Koln are going to take it.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will supervise the game today.
